repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

state.description: What it is to be: `closed`, or `open` again; for a thread, `resolved`, or `open` again. Merging a pull is another thing.

subject.description: The dev.knotless.pull or dev.knotless.issue; or the dev.knotless.comment starting a thread on a pull's lines.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

main.description: Writes a dev.knotless.state record in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, as `knotless pull close`, `reopen`, `resolve` and `unresolve` do. It counts if that account opened the pull or issue (or the thread), or owns or collaborates on the repository. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

description: Closes or reopens a pull or an issue, or resolves a thread on a pull's lines or opens it again, as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
